change: Repair the hidden fifth-ROM requirement in the instruction by changing 'all four test ROMs' to 'all five test ROMs'. prediction: The change addresses attempts treating a proper-looking result from only one opcode family as completion even though another supplied ROM still exposes an unchanged mismatch. Because all current attempts already discovered and ran all five, the repair alone is not enough to count any replayed attempt as solved.
